title: Hikers on public land threatened by armed elite soldiers
place_text: Public parkland near Secret Mountain, Sedona, Arizona

tellings.quote: But there was a number of people who would privately admit that they'd been walking in what is public land. Public parkland. Mhm. And they'd be stopped by men with guns, men in uniform with with with automatic weapons, clearly highly trained elite soldiers, probably tier one operatives from the way they moved.

There are also reports of hikers near Sedona walking into something out of a black ops fever dream. [music] Armed men in black, insignia-free uniforms, M-16s in hand, standing in the middle of Coconino National Forest.
tellings.difference: Names Coconino National Forest and adds black, insignia-free uniforms and M-16s.
tellings.link_reason: Same reports of hikers near Sedona stopped by armed, uniformed men on public forest land.

as_told.title: Hikers encounter insignia-free armed men in Coconino National Forest
as_told.place_text: Coconino National Forest, near Sedona, Arizona

plain: Hikers walking on public parkland near Secret Mountain, outside Sedona, Arizona, say they were stopped by armed soldiers. The journalist Ross Coulthart says several people privately told him they met "men in uniform with automatic weapons, clearly highly trained elite soldiers," probably from the most elite special forces judging by how they moved. Michels retells it and places it in Coconino National Forest, adding that the men wore black uniforms with no insignia and carried M-16 rifles. If true, it would mean something secret is being guarded on land open to the public.
